answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 963 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the opal. The ivory index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the dawn queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Honest users pay that once, farms 24 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
